# Process all files except the one already imported
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='/home/glen/documents/personal/simple_note/', entry_type='files')
for file_path in files:
    if file_path.endswith('Book_Reading_Lists.md'):
        continue  # already created
    # Extract filename without extension
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    if filename.endswith('.md'):
        base = filename[:-3]  # remove .md
    else:
        base = filename
    title = base.replace('_', ' ')
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)['content']
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note for {filename}: {result}")

GOAL
Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/simple_note/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- supervisor.show_profile()
- file_system.login(username, password)
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- file_system.show_directory(access_token, directory_path, entry_type)

API DOCS ALREADY READ (exact signatures; do not call api_docs again for these)
- file_system apis: show_account, signup, delete_account, update_account_name, login, logout, send_verification_code, verify_account, send_password_reset_code, reset_password, show_profile, search_notes, create_note, show_note, delete_note, update_note, add_content_to_note
